# Clear Dessert Pack

> Clear Dessert Pack is an international B2B dessert-packaging sourcing brand operated by Hangzhou Huikai Packaging. The site covers clear dessert containers, custom branding accessories, packaging kits and buyer guidance for wholesale projects.

## Company and contact

- Operator: Hangzhou Huikai Packaging
- Brand: Clear Dessert Pack
- Website: https://www.cleardessertpack.com/
- Business model: B2B wholesale sourcing and custom packaging support
- Primary markets described on the site: United States and United Kingdom
- Email: sales@cleardessertpack.com
- WhatsApp: +86 190 3200 3411
- Company and supply-chain overview: https://www.cleardessertpack.com/factory
- Wholesale inquiry: https://www.cleardessertpack.com/contact

## Purchasing notes

- Product specifications, material options, carton packing, MOQ, sample arrangements and production lead time must be confirmed for the selected item and order.
- Food-contact declarations or test reports depend on the exact material, supplier, printing method and destination market. Do not assume a certification applies until the supporting document has been matched to the product.
- Public product pages do not publish final transaction prices. Request a project quotation using the contact page.
- When citing product dimensions, capacity or carton quantity, use the relevant product or size-chart page as the source.
